notes:
Independent saved-art review for Round 17 Part C4, round 2. Read BRIEF-17 in full, both panel briefs, the NOTES method sections, cycle-4 FIXES and all five neighbouring panel reviews, and critic-r17E-4. The final critic-only instruction controls: no production art/compositor edits, drawing, branch changes, commits or pushes. Only this JSON and critic-r17C4-2-*.png review composites were written. The coordinator's 40x30-cell final overrides the earlier approximate 1200x900 showcase size. The brief's specified gate/tower footprints and twice-R15 sign scale take precedence over conflicting panel enlargement/shrink proposals; 64x72 sign assemblies have not been failed merely for their bracket-inclusive dimensions. Live engine collision/reveal code is outside this art review.

Coverage: all 106 exports in r17-C4-files.json inspected at literal 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x on 35 new piece sheets, alongside the reference houses and neighbouring approved art. The full native city was inspected and divided into sixteen native/4x detail tiles; targeted 8x views cover the clipped booth and northwest contact. Checked the requested final crops, squint and native comparison, roof/house/tall-low/wall/staggered/actor proofs and retained L-block/market/height regressions. Seven ground families were viewed in literal 3x3 repeats: workyard-c4, main-paving-c4, cobble-c3, street-main-c3, street-side-c3, lane-c3 and ditch-c3. Twenty C4 signs, people, fences and service props were mounted over summer grass and the actual workyard ground. There are no C4 seasonal partners, so seasonal-ground and summer/season-mask tests are not applicable. The 24 slate/brown roof colour partners retain their source alpha masks exactly.

Technical checks pass: all 106 export dimensions and SHA-256 values match the current inventory; alpha is only 0/255 and RGB beneath transparent pixels is zero. The six complete 96x48 ground/storey/inn facade modules match the prescribed course rows 0 and 47 exactly. Independently replayed all 58 retained registered component reductions (28,819,456 source RGBA samples, exact 8x8 modal sampling) with zero mismatches. This replays the retained processing record and does not claim a new drawing operation. Fresh read-only composition reproduces r17-city-final.png exactly. The 3840x2880 2x output, three 3x crops, native three-panel comparison and greyscale conversion all reproduce the expected source pixels exactly.

The layout really has been reworked: stepped frontages, bends, side-facing entrances, a gate-road inn, varied heights and uneven wall towers are visible. The native final is 1920x1440 (40x30 cells). Its 46 lot buildings have storey histogram {1:7, 2:15, 3:17, 4:6, 5:1}; 7/46 = 15.22% are one-storey. Counting the four lean-tos, stable/storage range and market hall as six additional one-storey structures gives {1:13, 2:15, 3:17, 4:6, 5:1}, 13/52 = 25%, still within the stated cap. Civic towers and curtain towers are excluded from residential storey counting. No exposed lawn remains along the final city's street frontages. The six-stall square is populated and the gate/main route/landmarks read in greyscale. These improvements pass and are not replaced by a claim that only colours changed.

Prior-critic repairs credited: the curved/beaded ridge family and duplicate tower/side-wall variants have been replaced; the northwest doubled eave now has one readable receiving contact; the west/east gate connectors and tower/curtain ownership remove the former bypass and cut-through; side-house drawings provide actual directional elevations; the large signs now occupy reserved blank bays rather than principal windows; the northwest shed/laundry yard reads as serviced space. The individual valley/end PNGs are not rejected merely because compose.py misplaces their slopes: their mandatory assembled acceptance proofs are explicitly failed instead.

The specific Part E regressions are repaired: the L-block's first five north-rear caps resolve to roof-back-w2, roof-back-w1, roof-back-w1, roof-back-w2, roof-back-repair-w1 (maximum identical pixel identity twice). Each market trade row now resolves four distinct ground-front pixel identities rather than four copies of ground-shop-v1-w2-c0; doors and signs remain readable. This does not waive the new all-floor repetition failures in the C4 final and five-staggered-lot proof. The reported 355-instance/111-window C4 audit with zero failures omits all 14 sign-bay storeys and divides connected floor runs by level, so it is not evidence of universal compliance.

Remaining failures concern FIXES 3/5/8/10/13/15/16/18 and coordinator gap/stray-boundary priorities: the clipped narrow court, repeated visible window/floor instances and incomplete audit, broken adapter assemblies, and unfinished rear-property/infill geometry. Other passing pieces are not failed by association. In particular, the street crop passes after the northwest junction/yard repair; the square and gate crops fail only for defects actually inside their bounds. Review is of saved artwork and composition, not an in-engine playtest.
